meta.title: Care leavers aged 17-21: activity (education, employment, training) by local authority
meta.geography: LA (responsible authority), region, England; Bedfordshire recomputed from summed counts
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics from the SSDA903 children looked after return; activity recorded around the care leaver's 17th-21st birthday (census of eligible care leavers).
meta.limitations: Very small LA numbers: counts rounded/suppressed ('c', 'low', 'x' -> null) and percentages to whole numbers, so year-to-year LA changes are noisy. Responsible LA, which may differ from where the young person lives. 'Activity not known' / 'no information' categories reduce comparability. Reporting year = year ending 31 March.

indicators.label: Care leavers NEET (%)
indicators.description: % of care leavers (17-18 or 19-21) not in education, employment or training.

indicators.label: Care leavers in education, employment or training (%)
indicators.description: % of care leavers in education, employment or training.

indicators.label: Care leavers by activity (%)
indicators.description: % of care leavers in each activity category (breakdown names the activity).

indicators.label: Care leavers (number)
indicators.description: Number of care leavers in the age group (denominator).
